# Yen Theme — Settings Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/build-settings-reference.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting the Theme Editor exposes, grouped the way the editor groups them.
381 settings across 9 sections.

Every section except Yen Theme and Lookbook comes from Cornerstone and holds storefront
wording and platform styling. They are listed for completeness, but a
store that sells in one language rarely needs to touch them — BigCommerce fills them
from the theme's language files.

| Section | Settings |
| --- | --- |
| Yen Theme | 91 |
| Global | 43 |
| Header and footer | 34 |
| Homepage | 3 |
| Products | 43 |
| Buttons and icons | 25 |
| Checkout page | 68 |
| Payment buttons | 33 |
| Lookbook | 41 |

| Setting | ID | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lazyloading Mode | `lazyload_mode` | select: Lazyload, Lazyload with LQIP, Disabled |

Cornerstone doesn’t load most images until the user scrolls to them on the screen. Enable "Lazyloading with LQIP" below if you prefer to show a preview image and replace it with a better quality version as the user scrolls. Select "Disabled" below to fully turn off this feature.
